design_philosophy.visual_style: Swiss High-Contrast meets Terminal UI. Dark mode default. Sharp edges. Monospace accents.

headings.name: JetBrains Mono
headings.usage: All headings (h1-h6), data values, tickers, and buttons.

body.name: Inter
body.usage: Long form text, labels, navigation, tooltips.

usage_rules.primary_action: Use Primary Green (#00E599) for 'Buy', 'Execute', 'Confirm', and primary CTAs.
usage_rules.neutral_surface: Use Zinc-900 (#18181b) for cards and panels. Avoid pure black for surfaces.
usage_rules.text_hierarchy: Headings in White (#fafafa). Secondary text in Zinc-400 (#a1a1aa).

buttons.style: Sharp edges (rounded-sm). Uppercase text. Monospace font.

cards.style: Flat background (Zinc-900). 1px Border (Zinc-800). No shadow or very subtle shadow.

inputs.style: Flat background. 1px Border. Monospace text. Sharp edges.

navigation.style: Sticky top. Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md) with border-b border-border/40.

visual_enhancers.gradients: NO gradients for backgrounds. Subtle gradients allowed for text highlights or active borders only.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders are preferred over shadows for separation.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise texture allowed on landing page background.

media.image_style: High contrast, desaturated or duotone (Green/Black). Technical/Abstract subjects.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text. Use APCA for critical data.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add 'JetBrains Mono' and 'Inter' from Google Fonts to index.html or CSS.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the colors and font families defined above. Set default border radius to 0px or 2px.
3. SCAFFOLD PAGES: Create Home (Landing), Login, and Dashboard pages using the layout rules.
4. USE SHADCN: Use shadcn/ui components but customize them to match the 'Sharp/Technical' aesthetic (remove rounded corners).
5. LANDING PAGE: Use the 'hero_background' image with a dark overlay. Use large JetBrains Mono headings.
6. DASHBOARD: Create a dense grid layout. Use the 'Card' component for widgets. Keep it empty but structured.
7. LOGIN: Simple centered form on a dark background. Sharp inputs.
8. HEALTH CHECK: Ensure backend has /health endpoint.
9. DO NOT use gradients for main backgrounds. Keep it flat and clean.
10. ADD data-testid to all buttons, inputs, and links.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
